feature: Account security - GET /api/portal/account-security/graph-signals (routes/portal-account-security-graph.ts, built backend-only under #1593) wired into artifacts/portal/src/pages/account-security.tsx (part of #1595): the local failed-portal-login line on the Password card and the 'Your Microsoft 365 tenant' card (passwordAge / failedSignIns / deviceCompliance). Tenant-wide signals per lib/account-security-graph.ts's own documented reasoning - portal users have no verified identity link to an M365 UPN (#1751). localFailedLogins is real per-user local data, no Graph/license gate.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the route's auth gate, and the real four-field discriminated-union response shape (passwordAge / failedSignIns / deviceCompliance / localFailedLogins) for a logged-in customer, plus the page-side wiring reachability check.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (no portal login page yet): artifacts/portal has no login page today (#1648) - App.tsx's RequireAuth renders an honest 'Sign in required' panel for an unauthenticated visitor, the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/account-security-data-rights.json (#2996) and customer-home-overview.json (#2921) already document. The uiSteps below only assert what is honestly reachable today - once a portal login page exists, extend this manifest with a real login block + goto '/account-security' + assert on the real rendered data-testids (account-security-local-failed-logins / account-security-tenant-signals are already on the page) - no code change needed on the page side.

TENANT-WIDE SIGNALS CAN BE GENUINELY UNAVAILABLE FOR A GIVEN TENANT: failedSignIns needs Entra ID Premium, deviceCompliance needs an active Intune entitlement - the testbed tenant (mccawsoft2.onmicrosoft.com) has neither, confirmed via subscribedSkus (see docs/account-security-contract-pack.md section 8). This is asserted as a real discriminated-union shape (the field always exists, 'available' may legitimately be false), not asserted as always-true 200 data.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).
